bull_case: Bundling launch, satellites and applications can increase wallet share and customer lock-in.
bear_case: Government budget timing, launch failures and cost overruns can quickly impair program economics.
thesis: Customer value is strong but unit economics are still maturing. Rocket Lab has demonstrated repeat demand and a record backlog, yet the company has not proven sustainable positive owner cash flow at the current capital intensity.

evidence.claim: More than $437M of new launch contracts were signed in Q2 plus post-quarter periods.
FY2025 gross profit was $207.2M on $601.8M revenue.

counterevidence: Rocket Lab remains cash-flow negative on a standalone basis and the Iridium transaction materially increases integration, financing and dilution complexity.
unknowns: Neutron commercial readiness and launch economics
Long-run dilution cadence and owner FCF/share conversion
falsifiers: A major Neutron delay, persistent launch failures, failure to close/integrate Iridium, or continued double-digit share dilution without per-share FCF progress would weaken the thesis.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Growth is supported by contracted launch/space-systems demand and mission-critical customer value, not marketing/subsidy dependence.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Government exposure is material, but the company has multiple products, customers and end markets; no single customer/product/regulation is shown to be fatal.

next_checks: Neutron schedule, backlog conversion, post-close Iridium FCF, diluted share count, ATM usage

subscores.rationale: Launch reliability, responsive access and integrated spacecraft solutions are mission-critical to government and commercial customers.
Backlog and repeat launch/space-systems awards indicate expanding usage and customer commitment.
Gross profit is improving with scale, but company-level cash economics remain negative and Neutron economics are unproven.

uncertainties.rationale: Rocket Lab remains in a high-investment, acquisition-heavy transition with large execution variance.
